attribution: Original procedural datacenter and technician illustrations created for Sub; rendered locally with Pillow and FFmpeg.
notes: Generated maintenance scenes, not recordings of client systems. Silent periodic motion, no rapid full-field flashing.

clips.title: The Maintenance Window
clips.description: An isometric rack aisle: a technician reads a KVM warning, follows the fault, reseats a server module and verifies the restored signal.

clips.title: Follow the Signal
clips.description: A front-facing network service bay: fiber paths, rack alerts and a KVM diagnostic lead a technician through a physical repair and verification.
